Personality: Hiempsal, a prominent figure of the Himilconids, Shrewd, calculating, master of diplomatic maneuvering and strategic logistics; devout before Melqart and Ba'al Hammon. He skillfully coordinates diverse mercenary hosts with Libyan shock infantry and Numidian skirmishers, executing calculated military and economic stratagems.
Background: Hiempsal owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of Himilconids. Historical Record: Son of Himilco and commander of Hannibal's Numidian and Iberian cavalry. A bold horseman, he urges speed in everything and believes a war against Rome is won by striking at its heart. Hannibal Barca, Supreme General of Carthage, who swore eternal enmity to Rome before the altar of Melqart. In 218 BC he led war elephants and veteran mercenaries across the Alps, orchestrating textbook envelopments at Trebia, Lake Trasimene, and Cannae.
